node.title: RS tangent flexible-budget unsafe floor
node.statement: For C=RS[F,D,k], integer agreement k<a<n, e=n-a, q=|F|, and B*=floor(q/2^t), one received line has at least e pairwise-distinct support-wise MCA-bad slopes at radius 1-a/n. Thus n-a>floor(q/2^t), equivalently q<=e*2^t-1, is an exact direct-value unsafe certificate. Since D subset F gives e<n<=q, no extra field-size premise is needed.
node.notes: HARVESTED 2026-07-27 from upstream prop:floor at b13de811; independently reconstructed in-node. This is a low-field direct-V supplier, not a safe-side converse.
